app.subtitle: |  Windows Git Multi-Account Manager
tip.capture_current: Save the current Git user config as a new profile
tip.path_link: Left-click to open the folder, right-click to copy the path
tip.apply_profile: Write this profile's user.name / user.email / signing settings to the global .gitconfig
tip.open_config_path: Open the .gitconfig folder in Explorer and select the file
tip.refresh_list: Re-read all entries from the global .gitconfig
tip.save_selected: Write the edited value back to the global .gitconfig
tip.delete_selected: Remove the selected entry from the global .gitconfig (confirmation required)
tip.gh_login: Run gh auth login (browser authorization); the account will appear in the list on the left
tip.gh_switch_selected: You can also click the Switch button on each row
tip.gh_logout: Run gh auth logout; only local credentials are removed
tip.gh_switch_row: Switch gh to this account now
tip.gh_cancel_login: Stop waiting for login (authorization in the browser is not revoked)
gh.device_auth_hint: Paste the device code on the GitHub authorization page and confirm. The account list refreshes automatically. The code is also copied to the clipboard, so you can press Ctrl+V.
ssh.title: Global Key Configuration
tip.ssh_create_key: Run ssh-keygen to generate a new key pair in the SSH directory
tip.path_link_dir: Left-click to open the folder, right-click to copy the path
tip.ssh_reconcile: Find public keys missing from the allowlist and allowlist entries that are stale
tip.edit: Open a separate window to view and edit
tip.delete: Move related files to the Recycle Bin (recoverable)
tip.create_whitelist: Create an empty allowed_signers in the SSH directory
about.author: Author:
tip.copy_env: Copy all the information below to the clipboard
tip.check_update: Open the GitHub Releases page in your browser
profile.title: Edit Profile
profile.signing_key_hint: GPG key ID or SSH public key path
profile.ssl_backend_hint: openssl: bundled with Git; schannel: uses the Windows certificate store. Leave empty to keep the current value when applying a profile
keycreate.name: Key name (file name under .ssh)
keycreate.identity_hint: Written verbatim into the .pub file as a comment and used as the identity in the allowlist. This text is public once the key is uploaded or shared
keycreate.whitelist_hint: Each allowlist line is 'identity algorithm public-key'; the Identity field is used here
keycreate.whitelist_need_identity: An identity is required to add to the allowlist
keyview.title: Key Content
tip.path_link_file: Left-click to locate the file, right-click to copy the path
tip.public_key: Safe to share; upload it to your code hosting platform
whitelist.title: Allowlist Content
whitelist.hint: One per line: identity algorithm public-key
reconcile.empty: Keys and allowlist already match; nothing to do.
reconcile.stale: Allowlist entries with no matching local key
reconcile.stale_hint: Allowlists often contain colleagues' public keys, so missing local keys are normal. Be careful when selecting them for deletion.
msg.name_email_required: Git user.name and user.email cannot be empty
msg.no_current_user: Git user name or email is not set; nothing to capture
msg.confirm_overwrite_profile: A profile for '{0}' already exists. Overwrite?
msg.select_account_first: Select an account in the list first.
msg.switch_hint: Note: you can only switch to accounts that are already logged in. Log in first if needed.
msg.login_in_progress: A login is already in progress; finish the authorization in your browser.
msg.no_login_in_progress: No login is currently in progress.
msg.no_device_code: Device code not received yet; wait a moment or start login again.
msg.select_logout_account: Select an account to log out first.
